dūtopasampadā.p: [Dūta+upasampadā] (thī) CL=8 As a monk allowed as the messenger.
a: ဒူတောပသမ္ပဒါ(ထီ)
တမန်ဖြင့် ခွင့်ပြုအပ်သော-ပဉ္စင်း-ရဟန်း-အဖြစ်။

K:
dūtopasampadā：ဒူတောပသမ္ပဒါ（ထီ）
[ဒူတ+ဥပသမ္ပဒါ]
တမန်ဖြင့် ခွင့်ပြုအပ်သော-ပဉ္စင်း-ရဟန်း-အဖြစ်။
DOP: 1 dūta m. , ~ī, f. ( and ~ā, f. ?) [ S. dūta, dūtī], 1. a messenger, an envoy; a proxy ; Abh 347 (~o tu sandesaharo); Vin II 277, 18 foll. (anujānāmi bhikkhave vyattāya bhikkhuniyā paṭibalāya ~ena upasampādetun ti, tāya ~āya bhikkhuniyā … evam assa vacanīyo, by attraction ?); III 136, 14 (sā kumārikā mātuyā santike ~aṃ pāhesi ahaṃ hi duggatā dukkhitā na sukhaṃ labhāmi); 138, 7 (dhuttā … aññatarissā vesiyā santike ~aṃ pāhesuṃ āgacchatu uyyāne paricāressāmā ti); Sn 415 (tayo ~ā upāvisuṃ); Vv 52:4 (yamassa ~ā); Ja I 139, 3´ (palitāni maccudevassa ~ā ti vuccanti); 139, 14´ (°-ttā); II 319, 19 (tasmiṃ janapade ~o smī ti vadantaṃ na vārenti tasmā mahājano dvidhā bhijjitvā okāsaṃ adāsi); III 146, 24* (~o ahaṃ rāj’ idha rakkhasānaṃ vadhāya tuyhaṃ pahito ’ham asmi, so read with Be, Ce ); IV 399, 26* (~ā vidhāvantu disā catasso); VI 472, 22* (paṭirājānaṃ sayaṃ ~āni sāsati; 472, 31´ : mama vacanena sayaṃ paṇṇaṃ likhitvā ~e pesesi); 528, 2* (avajjho brāhmaṇo ~o); Mil 18, 25 (arahanto … āyasmato Nāgasenassa santike ~aṃ pāhesuṃ); Vism 603, 30 (na ~ena mantodakaṃ pītaṃ rogino udaraṃ pavisati); — dūtehi in Ee at Pv-a 112, 30 : read assadūtehi with Be, Se ; — ifc see anudūta, assa- ( sv assa 3 ), deva-; — 2. (~ī, f. ) a female messenger, esp. a go-between, a procuress ; Abh 236 (~ī sañcārikā); — ° ôpasampadā , °’ûpasampadā, dūtenûpasampadā, f. , ordination by means of a messenger or proxy (see Vin II 277, 3 foll. ); Ap 610, 24 (magge dhutte ṭhite disvā labhiṃ ~aṃ); Sp 241, 12 (upasampadā nāma aṭṭhavidhā ehibhikkhu-upasampadā … dūtenûpasampadā, Be so; Ce, Ee, Se dūtena-upasampadā) ≠ Kkh 2 28, 21 ( Be, Ee 2 so; Ce, Ee 1 dūtena-upasampadā); Vin-vn 3017 (dūtūpasampadā); — °- vippahita , n. , being sent as a messenger; carrying messages ; Ja III 386, 11* (na ha nūna rājā jānāti … saṅgāme sukatantāni ~āni ca; 386, 22´ : ~āni cā ti gale paṇṇaṃ bandhitvā asukarañño nāma dehī ti pahitāya mayā … katāni dūtapesanāni ca).
NCP: feminine | duutopasampadaa ordination by means of a messenger or proxy.
